ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) RokRat / Dolphin C2 via cloud-storage APIs (pCloud, Yandex, Dropbox)
ucs.description: Hunts for non-browser / non-sync processes contacting the legitimate cloud-storage REST endpoints that ScarCruft's RokRat, Dolphin, and Chinotto implants abuse as bidirectional C2 (T1102.002). The combination of pCloud + Yandex + Dropbox + Google Drive API contact from a process that is NOT chrome/edge/firefox/onedrive/dropbox.exe is highly specific to this DPRK actor cluster.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443) by All_Traffic.src host All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.dest_host
| `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")`
| search dest_host IN ("api.pcloud.com", "eapi.pcloud.com", "cloud-api.yandex.net", "webdav.yandex.ru", "content.dropboxapi.com", "api.dropboxapi.com", "www.googleapis.com")
| eval process_name=lower(process_name)
| where NOT match(process_name, "(?i)(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|onedrive|dropbox|googledrivefs|yandexdisk|pcloud|safari|outlook)\.exe$")
| eval suspicious_parent=if(match(process_name, "(?i)(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|cmd|hwp|hword|certutil)\.exe$"), 1, 0)
| stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(dest_host) as dest_hosts values(dest) as dest_ips dc(dest_host) as distinct_cloud_apis values(process_name) as process_names by host user
| where distinct_cloud_apis >= 1
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let RokRatC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","www.googleapis.com"]);
let KnownClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","onedrive.exe","dropbox.exe","googledrivefs.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe","safari.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (RokRatC2Hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend SuspiciousParent = iff(InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe","hwp.exe","hword.exe","certutil.exe"), true, false)
| extend IsLolbinTrigger = iff(InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("hwp.exe","hword.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe"), true, false)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, SuspiciousParent, IsLolbinTrigger, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), HitCount=count(), CloudApisHit=make_set(RemoteUrl), RemoteIPs=make_set(RemoteIP) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SuspiciousParent, IsLolbinTrigger, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where SuspiciousParent or IsLolbinTrigger or HitCount >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RokRatC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","www.googleapis.com"]);
let KnownClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","onedrive.exe","dropbox.exe","googledrivefs.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe","safari.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Url has_any (RokRatC2Hosts) or HttpHostName in~ (RokRatC2Hosts)
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(SrcProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ProcName !in~ (KnownClients)
| where SrcUsername !endswith "$"
| extend SuspiciousClient = iff(ProcName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe","hwp.exe","hword.exe","certutil.exe"), true, false)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), HitCount=count(), CloudApisHit=make_set(HttpHostName), RemoteIPs=make_set(DstIpAddr) by DvcHostname, SrcUsername, ProcName, SuspiciousClient
| where SuspiciousClient or HitCount >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft RokRat Cloud Storage C2
id: 4f8a7c3b-2d1e-4a9f-bd5c-7e2f6a1b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects RokRat / Dolphin / Chinotto C2 beacons from non-browser processes to pCloud / Yandex / Dropbox APIs characteristically abused by APT37.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_host:
    DestinationHostname:
      - 'api.pcloud.com'
      - 'eapi.pcloud.com'
      - 'cloud-api.yandex.net'
      - 'webdav.yandex.ru'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
  filter_known_clients:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\onedrive.exe'
      - '\dropbox.exe'
      - '\googledrivefs.exe'
      - '\yandexdisk.exe'
      - '\pcloud.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\teams.exe'
  condition: selection_host and not filter_known_clients
falsepositives:
  - Custom backup or sync tools using cloud-storage APIs
  - Developer scripts using cloud SDKs
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.defender) @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.ru OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropboxapi.com)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\dropbox.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\yandexdisk.exe OR *\pCloud.exe OR *\pcloud.exe OR *\GoogleDriveFS.exe OR *\googledrivefs.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.pcloud\.com|eapi\.pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.ru|content\.dropboxapi\.com|api\.dropboxapi\.com)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|onedrive|dropbox|googledrivefs|yandexdisk|pcloud|outlook|teams|slack)\.exe$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: RokRat and the Dolphin successor have a well-documented signature behavior of fetching C2 commands and exfiltrating screenshots via the REST APIs of pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox and Google Drive (Kaspersky / ESET / Cisco Talos reporting from 2017 onward). The exclusion list pins down the unusual case — a non-browser, non-sync-client process talking to these endpoints — which is the actual RokRat i

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) HWP / LNK-in-archive lure → mshta / PowerShell loader chain
ucs.description: Catches ScarCruft's hallmark delivery: a Korean-language HWP document or a LNK file packed inside a ZIP/RAR archive (often double-extension or with a benign-looking decoy name) that, when opened, spawns mshta.exe or powershell.exe from an archive utility / hwp.exe / explorer.exe and writes a payload to %APPDATA% or %TEMP%. This parent-child chain is the canonical Group123 / Reaper / InkySquid initial-access pattern.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hwp.exe","hword.exe","hshow.exe","hcell.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","hancom.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe")) by host user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| eval suspicious_payload_path=if(match(process, "(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\(Roaming|Local)|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\)"), 1, 0)
| eval encoded_or_remote=if(match(process, "(?i)(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|DownloadString|DownloadFile|IEX|Invoke-Expression|hxxp|http[s]?://|\\.hta\\b|mshta.*http)"), 1, 0)
| eval double_ext=if(match(process, "(?i)\\.(pdf|docx?|hwp|jpg|png|xlsx?|pptx?)\\.(lnk|exe|js|vbs|hta|scr)"), 1, 0)
| where suspicious_payload_path=1 OR encoded_or_remote=1 OR double_ext=1
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let HwpArchiveParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hword.exe","hshow.exe","hcell.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","hancom.exe","hpinst.exe"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (HwpArchiveParents)
| where FileName in~ (LolBins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend CmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ParentCmdLower = tolower(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
| extend SuspiciousPath = CmdLower has_any (@"\appdata\roaming", @"\appdata\local\temp", @"\windows\temp\", @"\users\public\", @"\programdata\")
| extend RemoteOrEncoded = CmdLower has_any ("-enc","-encodedcommand","frombase64string","downloadstring","downloadfile","iex","invoke-expression","http://","https://",".hta")
| extend DoubleExtension = ParentCmdLower matches regex @"\.(pdf|docx?|hwp|jpg|png|xlsx?|pptx?|txt)\.(lnk|exe|js|vbs|hta|scr)\b"
| extend KoreanLureMarker = ParentCmdLower matches regex @"[\x{AC00}-\x{D7AF}]"
| where SuspiciousPath or RemoteOrEncoded or DoubleExtension
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SuspiciousPath, RemoteOrEncoded, DoubleExtension, KoreanLureMarker, InitiatingProcessSHA256, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let HwpArchiveParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hword.exe","hshow.exe","hcell.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","hancom.exe","hpinst.exe"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend NewProcLower = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentProcLower = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentProcLower in~ (HwpArchiveParents)
| where NewProcLower in~ (LolBins)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
| extend SuspiciousPath = CmdLower has_any (@"\appdata\roaming", @"\appdata\local\temp", @"\windows\temp\", @"\users\public\", @"\programdata\")
| extend RemoteOrEncoded = CmdLower has_any ("-enc","-encodedcommand","frombase64string","downloadstring","downloadfile","iex","invoke-expression","http://","https://",".hta")
| extend DoubleExtension = CmdLower matches regex @"\.(pdf|docx?|hwp|jpg|png|xlsx?|pptx?|txt)\.(lnk|exe|js|vbs|hta|scr)\b"
| where SuspiciousPath or RemoteOrEncoded or DoubleExtension
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, SuspiciousPath, RemoteOrEncoded, DoubleExtension
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft HWP / LNK Archive Loader Chain
id: 6c2d8e4a-7f3b-4d1c-9a5e-8b2f1c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the ScarCruft (APT37) initial-access pattern where Hancom Office (HWP) or an archive utility spawns mshta/powershell/wscript to drop a payload to %TEMP% / %APPDATA% or execute encoded / remote content. The double-extension lure naming is also characteristic of Group123.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1036.008
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_hwp_or_archive:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\hwp.exe'
      - '\hword.exe'
      - '\hshow.exe'
      - '\hcell.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zfm.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  suspicious_payload:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '.hta'
  condition: parent_hwp_or_archive and child_lolbin and suspicious_payload
falsepositives:
  - Hancom Office update launchers calling cmd / powershell with self-paths
  - Admin scripts unzipped via WinRAR that legitimately run PowerShell
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\hwp.exe OR *\HWP.EXE OR *\hword.exe OR *\Hword.exe OR *\hshow.exe OR *\hcell.exe OR *\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\7zfm.exe OR *\7zG.exe OR *\7zg.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe) @Image:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\cmd.exe) (@CommandLine:(*AppData\Roaming* OR *AppData\Local\Temp* OR *Windows\Temp* OR *Users\Public* OR *ProgramData* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *http\:\/\/* OR *https\:\/\/* OR *\.hta*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(hwp|hword|hshow|hcell|winrar|7zfm|7zg|explorer|hancom|hpinst)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(mshta|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\(Roaming|Local\\\\Temp)|\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|https?://|\\.hta)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData]), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
ucs.rationale: APT37's Korean-language targeting drives the inclusion of Hancom Office binaries (hwp/hword/hshow/hcell) as suspicious parents — almost no other tracked actor produces hwp.exe spawning mshta.exe or PowerShell in Western telemetry. The double-extension regex (.pdf.lnk, .hwp.lnk, etc.) matches the lure naming repeatedly documented by Cisco Talos (Group123) and ESET (Dolphin / RokRat campaigns). Pair
